李佳，张奕彤，金芝

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

DiffuCD: 面向扩散语言模型的高效对比解码

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007751 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

当前主流大语言模型大多采用自回归生成范式, 需要逐token生成文本, 难以满足实际应用对高效推理的需求. 扩散语言模型通过迭代去噪实现并行解码, 在推理效率上具有一定理论优势, 因而被视为提升大语言模型推理效率的一条重要技术路径. 然而, 现有扩散语言模型的生成质量仍有较大提升空间. 对比解码是一种被广泛证明有效的提升语言模型生成质量的方法, 其核心思想是利用能力较弱的业余分布对能力较强的专家分布进行校正. 然而, 现有对比解码方法主要面向自回归语言模型设计, 通常需要额外引入模型来提供业余分布, 这会显著增加推理开销, 削弱扩散语言模型高效推理的核心优势. 为此, 提出一种面向扩散语言模型的高效对比解码方法DiffuCD. 该方法基于一个关键观察: 在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中, 早期时间步由于可利用的上下文信息有限, 预测质量较低; 随着去噪推进, 预测质量逐步提升. 这一特性天然满足对比解码对分布强弱差异的要求. 基于此, DiffuCD直接将历史时间步的预测分布作为业余分布, 将当前时间步的预测分布作为专家分布, 从而对当前分布进行校正. 在4个扩散语言模型和6个评估基准上进行广泛实验. 实验结果表明, DiffuCD能够在多种模型和任务上稳定提升模型生成质量, 并且在吞吐量和峰值显存占用方面与未使用对比解码的对比方法几乎一致, 较好地保留了扩散语言模型高效推理的理论优势.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

面向复杂头文件的自动化分解与重构方法

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007556 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

许多代码文件随着软件演化逐渐膨胀并承担了过多职责, 严重影响了软件的可维护性和可理解性. 开发者常需要重构这些文件, 将一个大的代码文件分解成多个较小的子文件. 现有研究工作主要聚焦类文件的分解重构, 并不完全适用于分解复杂头文件. 这是因为分解头文件面临一些独有的挑战: 既需要考虑整个软件项目的构建依赖以降低编译成本, 也需要确保分解后的子文件之间不会存在循环依赖. 为此, 提出一种面向复杂头文件的自动化分解与重构方法——HeaderSplit. 该方法首先为复杂头文件构造蕴含多种代码关系的代码元素图, 其中就包括体现项目构建依赖的共同使用关系; 然后通过节点合并与多视图聚类算法识别关联紧密的代码元素聚类; 随后引入启发式的循环依赖修正算法生成可行的文件分解方案. 用户确认分解方案后, HeaderSplit能够自动执行重构, 生成新的子文件内容, 并更新软件项目内直接或间接引用原头文件的代码语句. 在合成复杂头文件与真实复杂头文件上对HeaderSplit进行评估, 结果表明: 1) HeaderSplit在准确率上比现有方法提升了11.5%, 并且具有更强的跨软件项目稳定性; 2) HeaderSplit分解得到的子文件模块度更高且无循环依赖, 具有更好的架构设计; 3) 使用HeaderSplit分解复杂头文件可以降低其演化历史中15%–60%的重编译成本; 4) HeaderSplit可以高效实施自动化重构, 在5 min以内完成百万行软件项目内的头文件分解重构, 具有很高的实用价值.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

基于大语言模型的非功能需求生成方法

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007557 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

在软件工程领域中, 非功能需求(non-functional requirement, NFR)获取一直是需求工程实践中的重要内容, 但容易被忽视. 传统的NFR获取方法主要依赖需求工程师的经验和人工分析, 不仅效率低下, 而且容易出现遗漏和不一致. 近年来, 大语言模型在自然语言处理领域取得突破性进展, 为自动化获取非功能需求提供了新的技术手段. 然而, 直接使用大语言模型生成非功能需求常面临知识幻觉、领域专业性不足等问题. 为此, 提出一种基于大语言模型的非功能需求自动获取方法, 实现高质量的非功能需求生成. 构建包含3856条功能需求和5723条非功能需求的结构化关联数据集, 形成22647对FR-NFR关联关系. 通过融合检索增强生成(retrieval-augmented generation, RAG)技术, 构建包含3个核心模块的系统化解决方案: 基于语义相似度的案例检索模块、面向非功能需求生成的提示工程模块和基于大语言模型的需求生成模块. 通过软件工程专家的专业评分和对BLEU、ROUGE等自动评分指标的多维度评估, 实验结果表明该方法在需求完整性、准确性、可测试性和一致性方面优于现有方法.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

业务建模驱动TRIZ注入的人-多智能体协作创新需求捕获框架

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007562 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

当前软件市场呈现出产品同质化加重趋势, 功能性创新已成为决定软件竞争优势的关键因素. 这促使现代需求工程研究范式从被动的需求提取转向主动的创新需求捕获. 在提升需求创新性的实践中, 现有研究主要呈现两条路径: (1)通过情景建模与引导方法改进工作坊流程, 激发人类团队协作创新; (2)基于组合创新理论对既有需求进行解构重组, 快速生成新需求方案. 但两种方法均面临创新质量与参与成本难以有效平衡的核心矛盾. 生成式AI技术的突破性进展为应对这一挑战提供了新思路. 提出一种业务建模驱动下注入TRIZ理论的人-多智能体协作式创新需求捕获框架BMHACT, 该框架以统一过程业务建模协作架构为蓝本, 设计提示词定义业务流程分析员、业务设计员等5个智能体职责. 多智能体团队通过“系统愿景收集-流程痛点识别-技术矛盾分析-TRIZ创新原理匹配-需求方案生成”的协作流程生成创新需求, 并由领域专家和客户代表对需求进行创新性评估. 以工程机械领域某企业门户网站建设项目为例的实证研究表明: 相较基于需求重用的自动化方法和基于对抗样本的追溯式需求生成方法, BMHACT迭代次数分别降低50%和28.6%, 全过程耗时减少66.7%和33.3%, 同时, 创新潜力指数CNU (clarity, novelty, usefulness)分别提升22.9%和10.7%, 且CNU单轮平均增益分别提高2.16倍和2.14倍. 证明了BMHACT在提升需求创新质量和降低协作成本上的优越性.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

面向领域自适应扰动的神经网络鲁棒性形式验证

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007568 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

神经网络鲁棒性验证作为保障人工智能系统安全性与可靠性的关键技术, 能够为智能决策提供形式化保证. 现有研究普遍基于数据分布各向同性的简化假设, 进行均匀 L p 范数球邻域上的验证算法开发. 但这一理论框架在面对现实世界复杂的数据特性时显得力不从心, 例如: 数据不同特征对模型预测结果的影响及其对扰动的敏感度表现出差异性; 某些特征受物理约束限制具有不可变性; 特征间还可能存在复杂的相关性结构. 这使得基于均匀扰动域的验证算法难以准确建模现实世界对人工智能系统的鲁棒性需求. 针对上述局限, 提出基于非均匀扰动域的鲁棒性验证框架. 通过结合具体应用领域的数据分布特性, 合理构建符合领域特征的扰动域几何结构, 并对领域自适应扰动进行建模. 在此基础上, 形式化地定义3种新型鲁棒性概念: 椭球鲁棒性、掩码局部鲁棒性以及马氏距离鲁棒性, 并提出相应的鲁棒性验证问题的定义与构建方法. 此外, 设计NNV4RADAP算法, 通过构建等价的均匀 L p 范数球鲁棒性验证问题来将现有的验证算法推广到面向领域自适应扰动的神经网络鲁棒性验证问题上. 实验结果显示, NNV4RADAP算法可以为神经网络提供更为精准且贴合数据分布特性的鲁棒性保证. 拓宽现有深度神经网络鲁棒性的形式定义, 并设计实现面向领域自适应扰动的神经网络鲁棒性的形式验证算法, 研究领域内基于数据分布的鲁棒性定义问题, 对于形式验证技术未来在可信人工智能技术中的落地和应用都有指导作用.

论文题名

基于语法和类型变异的TypeScript编译器缺陷检测

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007572 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

TypeScript作为JavaScript的超集, 提供了静态类型支持和面向对象等多种特性, 被Angular、Vue、React等众多主流框架广泛采用, 成为构建大型应用的核心技术之一. 其编译器负责将TypeScript代码编译为标准的JavaScript代码. 然而, TypeScript编译器本身可能存在缺陷, 导致生成的JavaScript代码包含难以预料的错误. 尽管在JavaScript引擎测试方面已有诸多研究, 但尚未有针对TypeScript编译器的系统性测试研究. 现有的JavaScript引擎测试方法既难以生成大量包含TypeScript特定类型的程序, 也无法有效变异这些类型, 导致难以检测TypeScript编译器中与复杂类型系统相关的缺陷. 为此, 提出一种基于语法和类型变异的TypeScript编译器测试框架TscFuzz. 为了获取大量包含TypeScript特定类型的种子程序, TscFuzz针对TypeScript相较于JavaScript的特定类型设计了一组提示词, 并引导大语言模型生成一系列包含特定类型的程序. 然后, 设计了一组类型特定的变异算子, 旨在通过类型变异对TypeScript的类型系统进行针对性的测试. 最后, TscFuzz基于交叉版本策略的差分测试, 比较不同版本的TypeScript编译器的输出结果来检测其缺陷, 并通过Node.js验证编译器输出JavaScript程序的语义正确性. 实验结果显示, TscFuzz在72 h内发现了5个缺陷, 比基线方法DIE和FuzzJIT分别多检测了2个和3个bug. TscFuzz的缺陷检测效果显著优于基线方法. 同时, 经过3个月的测试, TscFuzz发现了12个真实的TypeScript缺陷, 其中8个已被开发者确认, 7个已被修复.

论文题名

基于服务器无感知计算的对象存储跨云复制系统

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007623 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

对象存储是云计算环境下最常用的存储方案之一. 将对象存储中的数据复制到一个或多个云区域能够提升其可靠性和可用性, 并降低用户的访问延迟. 对象存储复制系统需要保障副本间的一致性并尽可能降低复制时延. 现有的开源跨云区域对象存储复制系统Skyplane尽管能支持主流云平台间的对象数据复制, 但无法保障数据一致性, 且在动态负载下复制时延较高. 为了实现动态负载下的低成本、低延迟对象数据复制, 提出基于服务器无感知计算的对象存储跨云复制系统FastRep. FastRep通过对象粒度的复制任务锁和乐观的复制与校验机制保障数据一致性, 通过时间有界完全树实现云函数快速调用, 通过自适应函数克隆应对带宽下降问题. 实验结果显示, FastRep能以分钟级延迟实现大小动态变化的对象数据的低成本复制.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

基于大语言模型的提交日志生成

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007640 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

提交日志是一类描述代码变更的自然语言文本, 对理解代码及代码演化过程十分重要. 受限于软件开发成本等因素, 开发人员往往不会精心撰写提交日志, 导致现有软件项目的提交日志质量堪忧. 鉴于此, 提交日志自动生成任务受到了广泛关注. 现有工作主要从开源软件项目中收集提交日志数据, 并基于此训练深度学习模型完成任务. 然而, 受限于开源项目数据质量, 现有工作难以取得令人满意的效果. 大语言模型通过在大规模代码和文本数据上的预训练, 学习丰富的语言规律和世界知识, 能够生成高质量、自然且符合上下文的文本, 为提交日志生成提供新的思路. 提出基于大语言模型的提交日志生成方法, 通过上下文学习、模型微调等手段将大语言模型用于提交日志生成, 使用两种示例检索方法增强上下文学习方法, 并从自然性和相关性角度分析生成文本, 研究大语言模型方法的优势与不足以及如何应对不足. 实验证实大语言模型的表现超过基线方法, 且思维链及更大规模模型能应对对代码变更理解不足的情况.

论文题名

时态信息增强的多样化推荐算法

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007577 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

近年来, 基于图神经网络(graph neural network, GNN)的推荐系统能够很好地利用交互数据的交互结构来学习用户和项目表示. 然而, 现有的基于图神经网络的推荐模型在聚合过程中往往忽略了交互的时态信息, 从而难以建模用户兴趣变化特征, 导致推荐模型对数据产生过度拟合, 造成推荐结果缺乏多样性, 难以满足用户更加多样化的需求. 针对上述问题, 提出一种时态信息增强的多样化推荐模型. 首先, 利用注意力机制来捕获历史用户-物品交互中的时态信息和交互结构信息并融合. 同时, 为降低特征冗余并提高表示辨识度, 设计特征分离模块, 将平滑的全局特征与突出且具有判别力的关键信号进行解耦. 然后, 通过邻居选择来突出节点间的差异并进行图卷积, 利用层注意力机制来缓解过平滑问题. 最后, 通过重加权损失增强对长尾类别项目的学习以增强多样性. 通过在3个数据集上的大量实验验证, 结果表明所提方法可以在实现最佳多样性的同时, 保持较高的准确性.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

基于核心-边缘结构感知的图对比学习方法

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007579 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

图自监督学习旨在无需人工标注的条件下学习有效的图结构表示. 尽管图对比学习(graph contrastive learning, GCL)通过构造标签保持不变的扰动视图并最大化其与原始视图的相似性来实现自监督训练, 但现有方法普遍采用全局均匀扰动策略, 未能考虑真实网络中节点角色的异质性——这种无差别的随机破坏会违反标签不变性假设. 实际观测表明, 真实网络普遍呈现核心-边缘的双层拓扑架构: 核心节点通过高度互连形成信息枢纽, 对其进行破坏性扰动将导致语义失真与标签偏移. 针对上述问题, 提出基于核心-边缘结构感知的图对比学习框架, 其创新性体现在: (i)摒弃全局均匀扰动范式, 通过核心-边缘检测算法精准定位边缘节点, 实施局部扰动以保持核心拓扑完整性, 严格遵循标签不变性原则; (ii)设计边缘节点删除等增强操作, 模拟真实网络的动态演化过程, 强制模型捕获拓扑稳定性与噪声鲁棒性特征; (iii)构建核心-边缘对比损失函数, 对不同结构重要性的节点在损失计算中赋予差异化权重, 有效引导模型关注核心信息并抑制边缘潜在的负面干扰. 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明, 所提方法在多个任务中均显著优于现有最优模型.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

融合对抗学习与多视图网络的鲁棒多模态情感分析

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007628 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

提高模型对特征噪声的鲁棒性已经成为多模态情感分析(multimodal sentiment analysis, MSA)领域最具挑战性的任务之一, 近期的研究已经提出了考虑缺失模态的高效MSA模型. 然而, 现有方法通常只关注特定类型的缺陷, 导致在同时存在多种类型噪声的实际场景中模型鲁棒性和泛化性弱, 而且现有研究忽略了不同模态之间的深层交互, 难以全面理解多模态情感信息. 针对这些问题, 提出一种融合对抗学习与多视图网络的鲁棒多模态情感分析网络(robust multimodal sentiment analysis integrating adversarial learning and multi-view network, ALMV). 具体而言, 首先使用时间模态特征缺失作为噪声数据, 与完整序列构成噪声-原始实例对以构建增强数据. 其次, 通过时间卷积和Transformer编码器提取噪声-原始实例对中每个模态序列的局部信息和全局信息, 并构建权重调控的多视图网络来学习噪声-原始实例对之间的多模态联合表示. 然后, 提出一种具有语义重建监督的多重对抗训练策略, 在模态级和话语级两个层面学习噪声和完整数据之间的统一联合表征. 最后, 在公开数据集上进行了大量实验, 对多种类型噪声场景下ALMV的性能进行测试. 实验结果表明, ALMV方法有效地提升了多模态情感分析在多种异构数据缺陷场景下的性能和鲁棒性.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

SPBSpark: 高查询效能的分布式轨迹索引方法

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007554 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

GPS (global positioning system, 全球定位系统)移动设备与5G (5th generation mobile communication technology, 第5代移动通信技术)互联网技术的普及催生了轨迹数据的飞速增长. 如何对海量轨迹数据进行高效的存储、管理和分析成为当前环境下的研究热点问题. 传统的单节点式轨迹索引受限于内存容量、磁盘I/O速度等问题已经无法胜任海量轨迹数据的管理. Spark作为一种基于内存计算的分布式框架, 在处理海量数据时具备天然的优势. 因此, 提出基于Spark平台的分布式轨迹数据索引以及相关的查询技术方案. 为了提升分布式集群中单个节点的数据存储能力和轨迹查询效率, 首先提出一种轨迹编码技术(Z-order trajectory encoding, ZTE), 该技术对轨迹MBR (minimum bounding rectangle, 最小外接矩形)所覆盖的最小相邻子空间进行编码, 可以表达不同粒度的轨迹以及轨迹的运动方向, 用于判断轨迹与查询空间的关系. 基于这一技术, 将轨迹的ZTE编码进一步组织成偏序结构, 设计基于子空间偏序分支的SPB分支(subspace partial-order branch, SPB)并结合哈希映射表IDMap构建局部索引. 索引能够避免类R树索引中最小限定矩形堆叠形成死空间导致的效率低下问题, 实现快速剪枝. 为了支持海量轨迹数据的高效检索, 基于SPB分支的局部索引设计分布式的轨迹索引SPBSpark. SPBSpark主要包括数据分区、局部索引和全局索引这3个部分. 该索引能有效支持时空范围查询、k近邻查询、移动对象轨迹查询这3种查询. 最后, 选取了同样基于Spark框架的分布式轨迹索引TrajSpark和LocationSpark作为实验对照对象. 通过仿真实验对比分析, SPBSpark索引的空间利用率在LocationSpark上改善了约15%. 在查询性能上, 相较于TrajSpark和LocationSpark, SPBSpark拥有2–3倍的性能提升.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

大容量高并发下数据库稳定性优化研究

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007625 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

数据库系统作为大数据基础设施的关键支撑, 其性能表现直接影响着上层应用的服务质量. 近年来, 随着新型存储硬件的不断发展, 数据库系统在应对大容量高并发场景时暴露出明显的稳定性缺陷, 实际测试发现, 数据库在大规模负载下性能劣化极其严重, 吞吐量普遍较低且出现失稳现象. 通过对运行过程中关键指标的监控和分析, 将问题定位到数据库的I/O读写模型, 认为I/O流程的缺陷导致数据库在大规模负载下刷脏不及时, 业务线程无干净页可用是引起稳定性下降的根本原因. 以缓冲区为对象将数据库I/O抽象为生产者-消费者模型, 分析该模型存在的功能耦合问题, 据此提出了新的功能解耦I/O模型, 对数据库的刷脏机制和干净页产出机制进行深度优化以提高干净页的产出效率, 并将改进后的NSGA-II算法应用到刷脏场景中用于多目标白盒化参数调优. 最后, 使用TPC-C和sysbench这2种常用的基准测试, 从数据规模、测试时间、并发数、读写模式等维度, 结合消融实验对该方案进行全面评估, 实验结果表明, 对于事务执行的平均吞吐量、稳定性、延迟等指标而言, 提出的整体方案相较于基线方案以及其他优化方案均取得了明显优化效果.

基于流谱的网络流量威胁检测理论及应用

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007615 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

随着网络技术的飞速发展, 频频发生的网络攻击事件, 尤其是高级持续性威胁(advanced persistent threat, APT), 严重影响国家安全和社会稳定. 在当前网络流量加密、混淆、伪装技术不断发展的背景下, 网络流量的智能化分析可以有效提高网络威胁的检测能力. 但在处理海量的网络流量数据时, 现有诸多方法仍存在分析复杂度高、模型可解释性弱等问题. 流谱以“域变换”作为总体解决思路, 通过为网络流数据构建更加精确、可分离度更高、可观测性更好的描述空间, 实现对网络行为的高效刻画、表征与分析, 从而有效解决上述问题. 类比原子光谱, 提出一套新的流谱方案. 该方案核心思想是通过将网络流映射到一维谱空间实现对网络行为的具象表征, 并以流谱比对方式检测网络流量威胁, 其中良好的流谱分解器设计是关键. 基于半监督自编码器构造流谱分解器并结合数据重构、类型分类任务完成训练, 从而使不同网络行为的谱线分布具有良好的可分性. 该方案在NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15和CIC-DDoS2019数据集上进行验证. 实验结果表明, 所提出的流谱方案对网络威胁行为在实现高准确率识别的同时, 可以差异化表征不同网络流量行为, 使得网络行为的可观测性显著提高, 从而增强检测方法的可解释性. 因此, 所提出的流谱方案对网络流威胁行为检测是有效的.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

基于可控迁移性对抗样本的黑盒图像分类模型验证方案

期刊：软件学报 · DOI：10.13328/j.cnki.jos.007632 · 语言：zh · 摘要来源：已核验来源

随着机器学习即服务(machine learning as a service, MLaaS)商业模式的快速普及, 第三方API服务中的模型替换欺诈问题日益严重: 服务商声称提供先进模型但实际部署低性能替代品. 这种欺诈行为不仅严重损害了用户的利益, 还影响了MLaaS生态圈的公平性, 在医疗诊断、自动驾驶等高风险应用领域可能造成灾难性后果. 现有的黑盒模型验证方法面临两大根本局限: 基于模型水印的方法需要干预模型的训练阶段; 查询-响应分析方法受制于图像模型输出的信息稀疏性问题而效果不佳. 发现不同架构模型对可控迁移性对抗样本的响应模式存在独特且稳定的差异, 并将其转化为模型的行为指纹, 提出基于可控迁移性对抗样本的黑盒图像分类模型验证方案MVCAE (model verification via controllable adversarial example). MVCAE通过多目标优化框架生成具有精确可控迁移性的对抗样本, 其不会影响指定保护模型的性能而对其他模型具有高攻击成功率. MVCAE的核心技术包括: (1)基于自适应令牌调整和梯度对抗的可控迁移性对抗样本生成方法, 通过令牌梯度方差调节、语义引导的图像块丢弃和梯度对抗等技术实现迁移性的精确控制; (2)基于渐进式贝叶斯推理的层次化集成分类器, 融合决策树、随机森林和贝叶斯推理等技术, 实现高效模型识别. 实验结果表明, 在包含14个主流图像分类模型的黑盒模型验证任务中, MVCAE达到100%的识别准确率. MVCAE不仅能区分不同模型架构类型, 还能识别模型家族内的不同版本, 实现从架构级别到子模型级别的模型区分, 对于保障和维护MLaaS系统中的安全性和公平性具有重要意义.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Explainable breast cancer classification using machine learning deep learning and transfer learning across multiple data modalities

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10782-x · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

A data-modality-driven cross-model classification using machine learning, deep learning, and transfer learning with transparency analysis for breast cancer binary classification across two different datasets is explored in this work. The ML track evaluates five models: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Decision Tree. The Wisconsin Breast Cancer Diagnostic dataset, comprising 569 samples and 30 numerical features, is used for this evaluation. The DL track trains three convolutional architectures a baseline CNN, EfficientNetB0 with transfer learning, and DenseNet121 with two-phase fine-tuning on the IDC Regular Breast Histopathology Image dataset. The preprocessing pipeline for ML includes log transformation, stratified train/test splitting, and Standard-Scaler normalization to prevent data leakage. In addition, the DL pipeline incorporates balanced class sampling, a three-way 80/10/10 split; data augmentation; class weighting; and model-internal pixel rescaling. Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving 98.24% accuracy on the WDBC dataset and 91.2% accuracy on the IDC histopathology image dataset. The findings indicate strong predictive capability across both tabular and image-based breast cancer classification tasks. Furthermore, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques, including SHAP, LIME, and Grad-CAM, were integrated to enhance model transparency and interpretability, enabling better understanding of feature importance and decision-making processes in breast cancer prediction. The study highlights that the adaptability of the paradigm should be guided by data modality rather than blanket assumptions about model superiority.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Evaluating a proof-of-concept blockchain-based architecture for secure personalized learning environments using the CIAAN framework

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10811-9 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Personalized Learning Environments (PLEs) record fine-grained learner interactions, but most platforms still keep those records in centralized stores that can be altered without a durable audit trail. Blockchain work in education has mainly covered static artifacts such as certificates and micro-credentials, not the integrity of ongoing activity data. This paper presents PleAuth, a proof-of-concept architecture that writes SHA-256 digests of canonical xAPI statements to Ethereum Sepolia and uses OAuth 2.0 for role-based access to an off-chain Learning Record Store. The architecture is derived from CIAAN requirements (confidentiality, integrity, availability, authenticity, and non-repudiation). Testing used 1,000 simulated learners on modest cloud instances. A controlled demonstration showed that an off-chain LRS edit is exposed by hash mismatch against the on-chain digest; the exact number of scripted tamper cases was not retained after the prototype was decommissioned, so this result documents the detection mechanism rather than a detection rate. No successful authorization bypass was observed in 33,672 access events (Wilson 95% CI for a successful breach: 0.00–0.01%). REST API latency stayed low under moderate load; high-concurrency database writes increase response times. On-chain confirmation latency was not measured; in practice, public-testnet confirmation may introduce additional delays. Feedback from 90 students and educators is exploratory only, because the instrument did not use validated scales. The study shows that tamper-evident recording of dynamic learning interactions is technically feasible. It does not claim superiority over production LMS platforms.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

An optimized multi objective simulated annealing approach for efficient drone based product delivery

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10846-y · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Drone technology has revolutionized e-commerce and logistics by enabling cost-effective product delivery and increased revenue. Optimizing drone scheduling and routing is challenging as delivery locations increase and the solution space expands. The primary objective is to jointly optimize delivery scheduling and routing by proposing a Multi-Objective Simulated Annealing (MO-SA) approach that satisfies payload capacity and battery life constraints while using customer priority and delivery deadlines as urgency-based sequencing criteria. This research introduces a new scheduling and routing method by modifying a simulated annealing (SA) algorithm to optimize delivery sequences and routes. The method combines local search with the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm to generate initial neighbor sequences, refined by the SA process using Boltzmann distribution for acceptance probabilities. Across three 100-customer benchmark instances, MO-SA reduced mean delivery distance by 28.14–54.85% relative to the four evaluated baselines, with a mean runtime of 6.16 seconds on R101. Further experiments demonstrate reduced travel distances under weight constraints, a higher number of deliveries within the assumed battery threshold than the compared methods, and priority-based sequencing. A post-hoc graph-theoretic check confirms no customer duplication, consistent with Hamiltonian and Eulerian properties at the customer-sequence level. Overall, the proposed approach offers a constraint-aware solution with promising results at the tested problem scale, indicating potential for last-mile drone delivery applications pending explicit arrival-time modeling, scalability, and real-world validation.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

AI driven framework for optimized and resilient network slicing in 6G network

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10762-1 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

The advent of next-generation networks, such as Sixth Generation (6G, brings unprecedented demands for high security, ultra-low latency, exceptional reliability, and enhanced capacity. A critical enabler of these networks is reconfigurable wireless network slicing, which allows operators to deploy multiple virtualized network instances on a shared infrastructure, thereby enhancing Quality of Service (QoS). Achieving optimal QoS requires dynamic reconfiguration and optimization, which can be effectively realized through Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques. AI-driven solutions are pivotal in ensuring intelligent decision-making for network management and mitigating network slice failures. In this paper, we introduce an ensemble machine learning model to predict the optimal network slice. The proposed model’s performance is validated across diverse applications, including Smartphones, Smart Transportation, Smart Cities and Homes, Public Safety, Industry 4.0, Healthcare, and AR/VR/Gaming. Achieving an overall accuracy of 98.78%, the model demonstrates its potential to revolutionize network management in next-generation wireless systems.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Trustworthy DINOv2-based skin lesion classification with uncertainty quantification and robust learning from limited medical images

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10748-z · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Developing reliable automated medical image classification systems remains challenging because annotated medical datasets are often limited, lesion categories are highly imbalanced, and high-confidence errors can occur even when conventional classification performance is strong. This study presents a reliability-oriented skin lesion classification framework based on pretrained DINOv2 representations, Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) feature refinement, a lightweight multilayer perceptron classifier, and uncertainty-aware inference. DINOv2 is used as a pretrained visual backbone, while the downstream classification components are trained in a supervised manner on a lesion-disjoint partition of the HAM10000 dataset. Monte Carlo Dropout is employed during inference to quantify predictive uncertainty and support selective prediction, while post-hoc temperature scaling is used for probability calibration. On the fixed 992-image test set, the representative DINOv2 + MHSA configuration achieved an accuracy of 82.96%, weighted F1-score of 0.8342, macro F1-score of 0.7502, macro AUC of 0.9601, and weighted AUC of 0.9551. Comparisons with ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16, Swin-Tiny, and EfficientNet-B0 provided additional context for conventional classification performance. The reliability analysis showed that uncertainty-based error detection achieved an AUROC of 0.8293 and risk–coverage analysis obtained an AURC of 0.0502. Temperature scaling reduced the Expected Calibration Error from 0.0911 to 0.0369, while the Brier Score decreased from 0.2651 to 0.2467. The MHSA ablation showed improved feature-space organization and ranking-based discrimination, although threshold-dependent classification metrics did not improve uniformly. Limited-data experiments further examined performance when only 10%, 25%, 50%, and 100% of the training data were available. Overall, the study evaluates DINOv2-based skin lesion classification from both predictive and reliability perspectives and emphasizes uncertainty estimation, calibration, selective prediction, representation analysis, and data efficiency rather than claiming uniformly superior classification accuracy.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

FusionXNet edge for predictive maintenance under cross domain deployment shift

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10837-z · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Industrial predictive maintenance (PdM) requires models that remain computationally manageable while handling heterogeneous sensor data and changing operating conditions. This study evaluates FusionXNet-Edge, a compact multi-branch architecture that combines CNN, BiLSTM, GRU, and MLP components, with an auxiliary branch that receives physically motivated engineered features. The methodology assesses the model on the AI4I, MetroPT3, and Engine datasets using leakage-controlled preprocessing, a common single-step input dimensionality, fixed source-domain operating thresholds, and both in-domain and cross-dataset evaluation. The results show competitive in-domain performance while keeping the parameter count at approximately 16 000. Multi-seed ablation experiments show that the auxiliary physics-guided features yield only small, dataset-dependent changes in predictive performance, indicating that most of the model’s capability comes from the compact fusion backbone. Additional component ablations show that simpler variants can remain competitive in selected datasets, particularly under the single-step input configuration. Cross-dataset experiments reveal strongly asymmetric transfer behaviour, and additional schema-alignment diagnostics show that a common dimensional interface does not imply equivalent physical feature semantics across datasets. These findings position FusionXNet-Edge as a compact, deployment-oriented PdM architecture rather than a physics-constrained or universally transferable model. The study also identifies source-target distribution shift, operating-threshold mismatch, and feature-semantic differences as important limitations for cross-dataset deployment.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Data-driven insights into priority predictors associated with conception success in indigenous goats in Uganda

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10797-4 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Identifying predictors associated with conception success in indigenous goats is important for prioritising reproductive management in smallholder livestock systems. This observational study applied five machine learning algorithms, Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost (XGB), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN), to 900 doe-mating records from 240 smallholder farms across four agro-ecological zones in Uganda, of which 68% resulted in confirmed pregnancy. Twenty-five predictors spanning animal, health, management and environmental domains were evaluated. Feature importance was quantified using standardised log-odds coefficients for LR, normalised Gini impurity reduction for RF and XGB, and permutation importance for SVM and ANN, and cross-algorithm agreement was assessed using Kendall’s W. On the held-out test set ( n = 180), LR achieved the highest discrimination (ROC-AUC 0.691, 95% CI 0.617–0.764) and the best calibration (Brier score 0.221). RF and XGB showed higher sensitivity (0.910 and 0.869) but low specificity (0.241 and 0.293), while SVM and ANN performed close to chance (AUC 0.540 and 0.519). Overall discrimination was modest, so the findings should be interpreted as associations rather than as a validated predictive tool. Body condition score (BCS) at mating was the most consistently ranked predictor, ranking first in four of the five algorithms, with an LR odds ratio of 1.40 per standard deviation increase, corresponding to approximately 40% higher odds of conception. Rainfall (CHIRPS) and NDVI (MODIS) ranked among the top predictors in the tree-based ensemble models, while parity, disease events within 30 days of mating, Temperature–Humidity Index (THI) and FAMACHA endoparasite score were negatively associated with conception in the LR model. Kendall’s W of 0.48 ( p < 0.01) indicated moderate cross-algorithm agreement across the full predictor ranking. Domain-level analysis for LR, RF and XGB attributed 51–59% of total importance to animal-level predictors, 22–31% to environmental predictors, and 11–22% to health and management predictors. These associations are observational and do not establish causality. Within this dataset, pre-mating body condition, strategic deworming, timing of mating with pasture availability, and mitigation of heat stress emerge as priority areas for investigation, pending experimental validation. Predictors not captured in this study, including diet composition, forage type, mineral supplementation, grazing behaviour and water access, are acknowledged as limitations.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A semantic quality generation and class-aware contrastive learning network for corporate credit risk prediction

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10767-w · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Corporate credit risk prediction is an important task in financial risk management and intelligent decision-making, aiming to identify high-risk enterprises defined by bankruptcy outcomes based on corporate financial and operational information. However, existing methods mostly rely on structured financial indicators and still suffer from insufficient semantic representation, uncontrollable quality of generated textual descriptions, and limited capability in identifying minority high-risk samples. To address these issues, this paper proposes SMCCL-Net, a framework that couples semantic-view reliability with category-aware cross-modal representation learning. Multiple prompts are used to generate candidate financial descriptions, and semantic quality evaluation determines which candidate is used as the positive textual view of each financial record. The selected tabular-text pairs are then optimized in a shared latent space, where class frequency, subclass relationships, and cross-modal difficulty jointly determine their contributions to representation learning. Therefore, the main contribution lies in connecting quality-controlled semantic-view construction with minority-class-oriented cross-modal optimization, rather than in the isolated use of the individual techniques. Experimental results on two public corporate bankruptcy prediction datasets show that SMCCL-Net achieves the highest PR-AUC and G-mean among the compared methods, while maintaining ROC-AUC comparable to strong tabular baselines. The gains are therefore concentrated in minority-class recognition and balanced classification rather than uniform improvement across all metrics. Ablation experiments and representation space analysis further demonstrate that semantic quality filtering, cross-modal alignment, and category-aware mechanisms contribute positively to model performance. Computational analysis shows that online semantic-enhanced inference requires six LLM API calls per sample, whereas cached and tabular-only modes require no online LLM calls, highlighting the trade-off between predictive gains and deployment overhead. These results indicate that the proposed framework provides a semantic-enhanced representation learning approach for corporate bankruptcy prediction.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Quantum-inspired differential evolution with Elite Perturbation for high-dimensional portfolio optimization

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10814-6 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

High-dimensional portfolio optimization is a challenging computational problem due to its large search space, nonlinear objective structure, and practical constraints on asset allocation. To improve the computational tractability of Sharpe ratio-based portfolio optimization, this paper reformulates the original constrained model as an unconstrained single-objective problem by embedding equality and inequality constraints into the objective function through penalty terms. This reformulation simplifies constraint handling while retaining the financial interpretation of risk-return optimization. To solve the transformed problem, a quantum-inspired variant of Differential Evolution, termed Quantum-Inspired Differential Evolution with Elite Perturbation (QEPDE), is proposed. QEPDE extends the standard Differential Evolution framework through three complementary mechanisms. First, a good point set-chaos reverse learning strategy is introduced to generate a more diverse and well-distributed initial population. Second, a quantum-inspired population evolution strategy is designed to enhance global exploration and improve the flexibility of individual updates. Third, a dynamic elite pool with Cauchy-Gaussian hybrid perturbation is developed to preserve high-quality search information and reduce premature convergence. QEPDE is evaluated on the CEC 2020 and CEC 2022 benchmark suites, as well as four in-sample portfolio optimization instances involving 20, 40, 60, and 100 assets, and is compared with ADE, AVOA, DBO, DE, GWO, QHDBO, and WOA. On the CEC 2020 suite, QEPDE achieves the best results on 8 of the 10 functions at both 10 and 20 dimensions, with Friedman average ranks of 2.21 and 2.24, respectively. On the 20-dimensional CEC 2022 suite, QEPDE achieves the best results on 11 of the 12 functions and obtains the lowest Friedman average rank of 1.17. In the portfolio experiments, QEPDE achieves the highest mean penalized objective value on all four tested in-sample instances and the best or second-best mean Sharpe ratio across the four instances, while maintaining the full-investment constraint measure close to 1. These results indicate that QEPDE is competitive on the tested high-dimensional constrained optimization problems. All comparative performance statements in this abstract refer to the adopted equal-population-size and equal-iteration-count protocol rather than to an equal objective-function-evaluation budget.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

An efficient spatial-temporal attention network for low-latency isolated Indian Sign Language Recognition

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10623-x · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

About 63 million people in India live with significant hearing impairment, yet Indian Sign Language (ISL) is still poorly served by assistive digital tools even though it is central to communication within the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) community. We present STANet, a compact hybrid model for isolated ISL recognition that pairs a Time-Distributed Conv2D frame encoder with causal temporal convolution and multi-head self-attention. The contribution is not an individual module but the composition itself: the encoder feeds temporal convolution and attention with no recurrent layers, so the model captures motion across a clip while keeping per-clip inference cost low. We evaluate STANet on INCLUDE-50 and ISL-50 and compare it, under one shared pipeline, against 3D CNN baselines built earlier in the same study. The main evaluation is signer-dependent: the splits are stratified at the clip level, so clips from the same signers appear in both training and test. In that setting STANet reaches 88.36% accuracy and a macro F1-score of 0.8841 on INCLUDE-50, and 94.38% accuracy with a macro F1-score of 0.9399 on ISL-50. Residual errors do not spread across classes but concentrate in a few visually similar sign pairs. In an encoder-controlled ablation on a shared backbone, each temporal stage adds little on its own, while the two together account for most of the accuracy gain over the backbone. Paired McNemar tests on those per-clip predictions do not reach significance once corrected for multiple comparisons at this test-set size, so the complementarity of the two stages is reported as an observed effect size and not as statistically significant evidence. A separate leave-one-signer-out test tells a harder story: RGB accuracy falls to roughly 19%, but feeding pose landmarks to the same architecture recovers it to 58.4%, which points to pose geometry rather than raw appearance as what carries recognition across signers. Offline clip-level inference through an OpenCV pipeline takes 3.488 ms per sample on INCLUDE-50 and 3.481 ms on ISL-50 on an NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650; these timings come from that single desktop GPU, and the model has not been profiled on mobile or embedded hardware.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Federated learning framework with hybrid feature selection for heart disease prediction

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10658-0 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Since cardiovascular diseases are a leading cause of death worldwide, accurate and privacy-preserving prediction methods are essential. Traditional machine learning models often rely on centralized data, which raises issues with data security, privacy, and heterogeneous data distribution among healthcare organizations. This study proposes a federated learning framework with hybrid feature selection (FL-HFS) for heart disease prediction to overcome these challenges. The framework assures data confidentiality by enabling collaborative model training without exchanging raw patient data. In order to determine important clinical features and improve model efficiency, a hybrid feature selection methodology that combines variance thresholding, mutual information, and L1 regularization is implemented. The model is evaluated on a diverse Dataset under a federated learning framework. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms baseline federated learning models with an accuracy of 88.3% and an F1-score of 91%. The results show that the proposed framework provides a robust, scalable, and privacy-aware solution for distributed healthcare applications. Clinical trial number : Not applicable.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

An efficient visual sensing method for electric bicycle detection in complex elevator environments based on VGWS YOLO

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10840-4 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

As electric bicycles (e-bikes) pose severe lithium-ion thermal runaway fire risks within residential elevators, vision-based edge sensing has become a critical safety measure for smart building Internet of Things (IoT). However, precise e-bike detection in elevator cabins is severely hindered by heavy target occlusion and the tight computing limits of embedded sensing hardware. To address these challenges, this paper proposes VGWS-YOLO , an ultra-lightweight detection network built upon the You Only Look Once version 11 nano (YOLOv11n) architecture for resource-constrained elevator visual perception. Three coordinated optimizations are integrated into the network: the novel VoV-Ghost Cross Stage Partial (VoV-GSCSP) module strengthens deep feature representation while cutting computational redundancy; Wise-IoU version 3 (WIoU-v3) loss optimizes bounding box regression under heavy occlusion; and customized Soft Non-Maximum Suppression (Soft-NMS) effectively reduces missing detections in crowded pedestrian-vehicle scenes. Comprehensive experiments were conducted on a self-built dataset containing 4,864 real elevator surveillance images. VGWS-YOLO requires only 2.428 M parameters and 6.098 GFLOPs , achieving a frame rate of 157.38 FPS . Its mean average precision at IoU = 0.5 (mAP50) and recall reach 93.9% and 95.3% , surpassing the YOLOv11n baseline by 3.3% and 5.2% , respectively. Ablation studies further validate the synergistic gains of all three proposed modules. Balancing an ultra-lightweight architecture with high detection precision, VGWS-YOLO shows promising potential as an edge-oriented computing solution for real-time e-bike fire risk monitoring in intelligent building systems; practical inference performance on embedded hardware requires further physical on-device measurement.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Segment feature classification method for hepatocellular carcinoma detection from CT images

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10670-4 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) is a chronic liver cancer triggered by hepatitis B or C identified by abdominal pain and jaundice. Computed Tomography (CT) images are used to analyze the type of HCC as primary or solitary based on the infected ratio. This detection and classification utilize machine learning and correlation datasets for precise diagnosis outcomes. In this article, a Segment Feature Classification Method using Region Normalization (SFCM-RN) is introduced. The proposed method identifies heterogeneity measures between the extracted features under two differentiations: the normal and infected regions. The segmentation process is pursued based on null or fewer heterogeneity measures. The differentiations per region are normalized to identify the infection ratio that increases the classifications. Hence this differentiation to normalization case is iteratively verified using sectional deep learning where the single connected layer performs both normalization to differentiation and vice-versa. The iteration is halted if the maximum infected rate is identified through training inputs. The proposed method improves accuracy, F1-score, recall, and precision by 15.52%, 12.51%, 11.24%, and 11.98% respectively. The proposed method reduces error by 14.51% for the maximum feature set.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Prediction of secondary testosterone deficiency using a hybrid robust auto encoder and light gradient boosting model

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10773-y · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Testosterone Deficiency (TD), secondary TD in particular, is an endocrine disease which is very common in elderly men but often underdiagnosed during diagnosis. It consists of a range of physical, psychological, and metabolic disturbances that include loss of libido, fatigue, and depression, while the possibility of cardiovascular complications seems to increase among those with TD. Therefore, determination of secondary TD should be done genuinely and as early as possible so that the patient can be subjected to early remedial intervention and life improvement. However, conventional diagnostic methods mainly depend on symptomatic and isolated measurements of hormones, and these measures may, therefore, be insufficient for reliable detection. This study introduces an efficient and robust machine learning framework for the prediction of secondary testosterone deficiency using clinical and biochemical data. Preprocessing of data began with Min-Max normalization, then followed by random sampling to maintain scale consistency and class balance. A Relational Autoencoder (RAE) for the extraction of important features and to maintain the reduced dimensionality and subsequent optimized LightGBM classifier using histogram optimization (HO) technique for prediction with much better performance. The developed model represents a high-performance system with 96.61% accuracy, 95.86% precision, 96.19% recall, specificity of 96.92%, and an F1 score of 96.03%. Experimental evaluations exhibit that the proposed model significantly outperforms traditional existing models against the values of accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, and F1-score.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

LiveCtx context selection at query time for long conversational histories

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10807-5 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Long-running conversational agents must answer current questions from histories that can exceed a configured request budget. Sliding windows and rolling summaries reduce or rewrite history using rules that are not conditioned on the content of a later question. LiveCtx instead preserves the original sessions and selects context after the question arrives. Its Adaptive assembly policy uses the full history when it fits the budget; otherwise it retrieves complete selected sessions, leaves them unchanged when they fit, and compresses the selected set only once when it remains over budget. On 500 LongMemEval-S questions with Qwen3-Max generation and a common 131,072-character client budget, Adaptive achieved 79.8% and 81.8% accuracy when assessed independently by two automated graders. It exceeded Filter, which used the same retrieved sessions without generative compression, by 4.4 and 5.0 percentage points. The advantage was concentrated in the 342 over-budget retrieved sets and became small at the 160K-character budget, when 472 of 500 sets fit unchanged. In a fixed 50-question analysis, Adaptive used 42.2% fewer compression calls than per-session compression but retained fewer official target fragments. The evaluated policy therefore delayed lossy reduction until the question was known while keeping the original history available for later queries.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Privacy-preserving federated learning with differential privacy for secure distributed intelligent computing

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10795-6 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without centralized data sharing, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive intelligent computing environments. However, FL models remain vulnerable to information leakage through model updates and prediction outputs, particularly when learning from electroencephalography (EEG) signals. Although Differential Privacy (DP) can mitigate such risks, integrating DP into distributed deep learning often reduces predictive performance and destabilizes optimization. To address these challenges, this study proposes SAFE (Secure Adaptive Federated EEG Framework), a privacy-preserving distributed learning framework integrating representation-level DP, TLS-secured communication, and multi-round Federated Averaging (FedAvg) optimization. SAFE applies Laplace-based DP directly to normalized EEG representations prior to local training while preserving decentralized data locality. The framework was evaluated using EEGNet, ShallowNet, and EEGTCNet on the BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a under multiple privacy budgets ( ε = 1, 5, 10 ) across 20 communication rounds. Experimental evaluation using classification accuracy, convergence analysis, communication overhead, and Membership Inference Attacks (MIA) demonstrated that SAFE effectively balanced predictive utility and privacy protection. Among the evaluated models, ShallowNet achieved the strongest federated performance and convergence stability. The findings demonstrate the feasibility of integrating DP and secure communication into federated EEG learning without substantial degradation in predictive utility.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Explaining alignment between LLM classifications of political arguments and human judgments

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10793-8 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Large language models are increasingly used in civic tasks such as classifying political arguments, raising questions about when their classifications align with human judgments. This study examines whether LLMs can distinguish evidence-supported from rhetorical-value-based arguments and which linguistic and structural features explain their alignment with human annotations. We analyze 600 French and German arguments from Swiss referendum debates (1977–2016), manually annotated by type of justificatory support, and evaluate four models using logistic regression and linguistic features. Model–human agreement is moderate and uneven across models, and alignment is associated with broad structural features such as argument length, causality markers, and readability. Analysis of model-generated justifications shows that explanations are linguistically consistent with the assigned label and should be interpreted as post-hoc rationalizations rather than as evidence of reasoning.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Automatic candidates identification for Robotic Process Automation based on textual process descriptions

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10820-8 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Robotic Process Automation has been widely adopted across industries over the past years, evolving from a niche automation tool into a mature, commercially established technology. Nonetheless, the initial identification of suitable process candidates remains a critical and challenging step. The study concentrates on the automatic candidate identification from textual process descriptions based on the approach proposed by Leopold et al. We extend the original work through three principal contributions: the expansion of the training dataset with a larger, multi-domain corpus; the generation of several new features derived from consolidated process characteristics; and the comparison of several classifiers. Our experiments reveal that the contribution of the engineered features is limited, and identify the reason: two of the four features encode the same distinction, and that distinction carries no positive signal. Text representation has a modest effect, and the modern representations do not outperform plain word-level TF-IDF; among the evaluated configurations, the simple word-level TF-IDF with LinearSVC attains the best overall balance. Crucially, cross-dataset evaluation shows that models trained on synthetically generated text do not fully transfer to human-authored text. Overall, the study provides an empirically grounded assessment of the current limits and opportunities in text-based RPA candidate identification.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Edge-deployed graph learning for real-time telecom and financial fraud detection: a systematic survey and reference architecture

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10570-7 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Cross-domain telecom and financial fraud (attack chains that begin with a fraudulent SIM swap, intercept a one-time password, and clear an unauthorized transfer) now dominates high-value losses globally. Defenders restricted to a single layer see only half of the chain and routinely miss the relational coordination that characterizes modern fraud rings. Graph Neural Networks have closed the relational gap, but they are almost universally evaluated in centralized, offline settings, a regime structurally incompatible with the 100-millisecond latency budget of card-present payment authorization. This article systematically surveys 22 primary studies (2017 to 2025) at the intersection of graph-based fraud detection, multi-access edge computing, federated training, and blockchain audit, drawn from both the telecommunications venues and the broader machine-learning venues, and organized along a five-dimensional taxonomy. A coverage matrix exposes that no published system addresses all five dimensions simultaneously. We propose a reference architecture and identify five open research challenges. A two-experiment pilot implementation on the standard Sichuan Mobile CDR benchmark validates the spatial GAT backbone (F1 = 0.7737, AUC = 0.8039) and a FedAvg-based three-operator federated variant (F1 = 0.8622, AUC = 0.9263, Precision = 0.9364), with the federated configuration outperforming the centralized baseline on every metric, an outcome we attribute to implicit ensemble averaging and to cleaner per-silo graph structure. The result establishes that the regulatory and competitive obstacles to cross-operator data sharing need not be regarded as obstacles to high-accuracy cross-operator fraud detection.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Interpretable ESG risk analysis using decision trees and SHAP in applied machine learning

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10803-9 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

ESG classifications are commonly used for screening, but dependence on rating-provider data and repeated firm observations can lead to overly optimistic estimates. We examine 2,313 firm-year records for 488 Fortune 500 companies (2017–2021) using decision trees, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and four comparator models. The outcome is a relative high-risk indicator derived from the upper quartile of Bloomberg Risk_score. We re-evaluate all models under identical five-fold company-grouped partitions, fitting the 75th-percentile threshold, missing-value imputation and encoding within the training fold only. Mean grouped ROC-AUC is 0.723 (SD 0.065) for the decision tree, versus 0.809 (SD 0.049) for random forest and 0.806 (SD 0.043) for logistic regression. At the 0.5 threshold, the decision tree attains accuracy 0.692, below the 0.749 always-low rule, while sensitivity is 0.709. Identifying 80% of high-risk cases requires reviewing a mean 56.2% of observations within validation folds. Removing two aggregate Bloomberg predictors reduces tree AUC to 0.709; a broad exclusion reduces it to 0.653. SHAP makes model contributions auditable but does not independently validate ESG harms. The results support explanation-led exploratory analysis, not operational risk decisions without independent outcome validation and calibrated review costs.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Programmer expertise classification using cognitive load and transfer learning

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10760-3 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Context Evaluating a programmer’s performance by considering both technical and cognitive skills is indispensable in many software development tasks. Problem Technical skills are relatively easy to assess, whereas non-technical skills, such as long-term memory, critical thinking, and emotional intelligence, are often overlooked while measuring the performance of a programmer. Aim The primary objective of this work is to propose a reliable framework for classifying programmers into five framework-derived proficiency ranks. Methods Participants are given an assignment with both technical and non-technical questions. A cognitive load index that combines technical and non-technical skills is used to analyze performance and stratify it into five ranks. The proposed framework was evaluated using CatBoost and TabNet classifiers in a transfer-learning setup. It used the source dataset (Another researcher’s dataset) for pre-training and the proposed programmer dataset for fine-tuning. Extensive experiments, including confusion matrix analysis, 5-fold cross-validation, sensitivity analysis, and ablation studies, confirm the framework’s effectiveness and robustness. Results The fine-tuned CatBoost model outperformed the TabNet model, achieving an impressive 87% accuracy, a significant improvement over the pre-trained model’s 31%. The findings demonstrate that combining technical skills with non-technical aspects greatly enhances the accuracy of classifying programmer expertise. This offers a dependable method for assessing programmers in software engineering education. The study develops a robust framework for evaluating programming performance that incorporates both technical and non-technical skills, and it can be adapted for other cognitive and skill-based evaluations across different fields.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

An attention-enhanced CNN-BiLSTM framework with confidence-gated inference for arrhythmia detection using ECG signals

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10707-8 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Automated arrhythmia detection from electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is essential for early diagnosis and continuous cardiac monitoring. However, accurate classification remains challenging due to complex temporal dependencies in ECG waveforms and severe class imbalance, where clinically significant arrhythmias are underrepresented. To address these challenges, we propose an Attention-Enhanced CNN–BiLSTM framework with a Confidence-Gated Inference mechanism for ECG-based arrhythmia detection. The proposed model integrates a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) to capture local morphological features with a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network to model long-range temporal dependencies in ECG signals. A temporal attention mechanism is employed to focus on diagnostically relevant segments of the signal. Additionally, a confidence-gated inference strategy is introduced to improve prediction reliability, particularly for minority classes. An extensive ablation study across 18 configurations is conducted to evaluate the contribution of temporal modeling, attention, and inference strategies. On the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, the proposed model achieves an accuracy of 96.58% and a macro-F1 score of 86.05%. To ensure an unbiased evaluation free of test-set leakage, we further adopt a strict protocol in which all hyperparameters ( γ , τ ) are selected exclusively on a held-out validation set; under this leakage-free protocol the model attains an accuracy of 96.74% and a macro-F1 score of 86.54% on the untouched test set. These findings demonstrate that integrating attention-driven temporal modeling with calibrated inference yields efficient arrhythmia classification on the MIT-BIH benchmark.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Federated attention-driven client selection and aggregation for privacy-preserving human activity recognition

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10781-y · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Human Behavioral Context Recognition (HBCR) aims to identify user activities in real-world environments and has critical applications in assistive living, healthcare, and industrial automation. A major challenge in this field is achieving high model performance while ensuring user privacy, which is difficult for traditional centralized systems. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this by enabling decentralized model training directly on user devices. However, its success depends heavily on effective client selection and aggregation strategies. In this paper, we propose FAAM (Federated Averaging with Attention Mechanism), a novel framework that enhances FL by identifying and prioritizing the most relevant clients during each communication round using an attention-based approach. FAAM optimizes client selection and communication efficiency, resulting in faster convergence, reduced communication overhead, and equivalent model accuracy. We evaluate FAAM on four newly collected Human Activity Recognition (HAR) datasets, demonstrating that it outperforms state-of-the-art techniques in convergence speed and accuracy. Our results show that FAAM achieves optimal performance with fewer clients and communication rounds, making it an efficient and privacy-preserving solution for real-time HBCR systems.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A context-aware hybrid multimodal transformer framework for hate speech detection via contrastive annotation and graph-based semantic Expansion

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10776-9 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Social media increasingly provides avenues for the distribution of nuanced, contextualized, and multimodal hate speech that is challenging to detect through traditional methods. Unimodal and superficial multimodal fusion methods have been observed to lack the ability to recognize implied hostility in sarcastic, satirical, figurative, meme, and visually symbolic messages. In addition, the noise in labelling data, limited generalizability of lexicons, and binary classification systems hinder the performance of current models in practical settings. To overcome the aforementioned issues, this paper proposes a context-aware hybrid multimodal model for hate speech recognition based on polarity-guided contrastive labelling, deep cross-modal transformer fusion, disagreement-aware labelling refinement, semantic graph augmentation, and hate intensity estimation. The designed framework leverages contextual language transformers for capturing complex semantic relationships in the text data while deep visual encoders capture emotion-specific and context-relevant features from images. Cross-attention based fusion facilitates alignment between text polarity and image emotion in the semantic embedding space, facilitating detection of implicitly embedded and image-assisted hateful sentiments. In order to overcome inconsistencies in annotation process and increase prediction accuracy, an ensemble-based disagreement correction method resolves the ambiguity in labelling by considering the impact of uncertainty and disagreement between multiple annotators. Concurrently, a semantic hate propagation network captures hate context information using graph-based lexicon relationships, enhancing hate detection in more sophisticated and less explicit hateful stories that existing keyword-based approaches miss out on. Unlike typical binary classification, the proposed approach implements a hierarchical hatred density score technique that classifies hatred content into ordinal scales, offering better interpretation and practical moderation results. In extensive evaluations using standard and mixed multimodal datasets, the proposed approach consistently outperforms the best-in-class method in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The ablation study supports the positive role of all architectural components, while the computational analysis proves the viability for near real-time implementation. Finally, qualitative analysis highlights that the proposed approach generates explanations similar to human logic, especially for sophisticated scenarios of sarcasm, metaphorical hostility, and indirect hate speech.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A hybrid multiverse giza pyramid construction metaheuristic for robust engineering optimization

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10665-1 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Achieving an effective balance between global exploration and local exploitation remains a fundamental challenge in metaheuristic optimization, often leading to premature convergence or slow convergence on complex engineering problems. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel hybrid optimization algorithm, termed Multiverse–Giza Pyramid Construction Optimization (MV-GPCO), which integrates the complementary search mechanisms of the Multiverse Optimization (MVO) and Giza Pyramid Construction (GPC) algorithms within a unified optimization framework. The proposed method combines the stochastic exploration capability of MVO, inspired by white holes, black holes, and wormholes, with the deterministic local refinement strategy of GPC to improve convergence accuracy. This hybrid search mechanism enables efficient optimization in high dimensional and multimodal search spaces while maintaining an improved exploration–exploitation balance. The proposed algorithm is evaluated on CEC2022 benchmark test suite and constrained engineering design problems, and compared with 14 state of the art metaheuristic algorithms. Experimental results demonstrate superior performance, achieving faster convergence, higher solution accuracy, and improved robustness. Statistical analyses further confirm the stability and consistency of the proposed approach across optimization problems with diverse structural characteristics. These results demonstrate that MV-GPCO provides an efficient and reliable optimization framework for challenging engineering optimization applications.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Multimodal detection of cyber-physical attacks against intelligent traffic signal controllers

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10754-1 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Intelligent traffic signal controllers are increasingly connected to simulation, monitoring, and remote-management interfaces, expanding the cyber-physical attack surface of urban transportation infrastructure. This article presents GuardBox, a multimodal anomaly detection framework that monitors controller behavior, traffic command patterns, and cabinet sensor telemetry to detect attacks against signal-control logic. GuardBox combines a long short-term memory autoencoder for behavioral anomaly detection with a random forest classifier for attack-family attribution. The system is evaluated in a Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) testbed using 375 held-out scenarios spanning four attack families and normal operating conditions: timing manipulation, replay attack, physical intrusion, and combined cyber-physical attack. Because each attack family is injected by an explicit signature rule, the classes are separable by construction: in this controlled testbed GuardBox flags timing manipulation, replay, and combined attacks in every scenario of their classes (100%, 100%, and 100%), detects physical intrusion in 61/75 of cases (81%, an intermittent cabinet-sensor observability limit), and produces a 0% (0/75) false-positive rate on normal operation. Attribution is compared against classical classifiers (SVM, XGBoost, MLP, logistic regression) and deep-learning models (a 1D-CNN and a GRU network), and the detector against unsupervised baselines on the same telemetry; the pipeline is evaluated across three intersection topologies and under sensor noise and benign non-attack conditions. These near-perfect rates should be read as evidence that the injected signatures are separable in feature space rather than as a claim of field-level generalization. Denial-of-service flooding manifests outside the current telemetry and is therefore treated as out of scope.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A retrieval-augmented LoRA-Tuned LLM framework for structured software test case generation

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10718-5 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Modern software systems are becoming increasingly complex that require scalable and reliable testing mechanisms for quality and robustness. The manual test case design remains a significant limitation as it is time-consuming, inconsistent, and prone to human error when dealing with large-scale and evolving requirements. The existing automated models struggle to generate structured, semantically coherent, and contextually relevant test cases which indicates the need for more intelligent and efficient solutions. This study proposes a novel Retrieval-Augmented and LoRA-tuned Large Language Model for automated generation of structured software test cases from textual requirements. The proposed model combines the FLAN-T5 with Retrieval-Augmented Generation to integrate the contextual grounding and Low-Rank Adaptation for parameter-efficient fine-tuning that allows the high-quality generation to maintain the computational efficiency. The proposed model is trained on a large-scale custom dataset that contain real-world test case records collected from enterprise tools such as Jira and Zephyr, and generates structured JSON-based test cases aligned with industrial standards. The enterprise-style structured test-case dataset and controlled experimental protocol used in this study. The proposed configuration achieved a BLEU score of 0.5897, ROUGE-L of 0.8095, BERTScore F1 of 0.9679, and semantic cosine similarity of 0.9816. A duplicate rate of 0.000 and a hallucination rate of 0.017 were also observed under the defined evaluation criteria. The results indicate the potential of retrieval augmentation and parameter-efficient fine-tuning for structured test-case generation within the investigated setting. The enterprise dataset and trained artifacts are restricted and findings interpreted within the scope of the evaluated task rather than as evidence of universal performance superiority. The integration of retrieval augmentation results in a mean inference latency of approximately 6·27s per test case indicates a measurable computational overhead with the improved contextual grounding. The findings show a practical performance between generation quality and inference efficiency within the evaluated enterprise-style test-case generation setting.

ADAPT ClickNet a leakage controlled dynamic heterogeneous graph learning framework for fraud aware mobile install attribution

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10619-7 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Mobile install attribution requires identifying extremely rare attributed clicks from massive click logs under severe class imbalance, temporal drift, and leakage risk. Existing tabular, transformer, graph, and sequence-based click-prediction models commonly treat click records as static observations, exploit limited temporal interaction structure, weakly model heterogeneous relations among IP, app, device, OS, channel, time bucket, and click-event entities, and provide insufficient calibration for probability-based decision-making. This paper proposes ADAPT ClickNet, a leakage-controlled dynamic heterogeneous graph-learning framework for calibrated mobile install attribution. The framework integrates causal temporal feature construction, directed temporal click-graph construction, heterogeneous click–entity interaction modeling, a tri-branch encoder with tabular entity, temporal graph, and session-sequence branches, self-supervised click representation learning, click-specific three-way softmax fusion, and calibrated supervised fine-tuning. Self-supervised pretraining combines masked entity reconstruction, temporal order prediction, neighborhood reconstruction, session contrastive learning, and click-burst perturbation consistency. Supervised fine-tuning jointly optimizes focal binary cross-entropy, an AUC-oriented ranking loss, and a calibration loss to improve rare-event ranking and probability reliability. Evaluation is performed using chronological partitioning of a large-scale click log containing 184,903,890 labeled records. The internal test set contains 25,734,126 clicks, including 63,993 attributed clicks and 25,670,133 non-attributed clicks. ADAPT ClickNet achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.9856, PR-AUC of 0.7012, log loss of 0.00712, F1 score of 0.5328, precision at the top 1% of 0.2114, and recall at the top 1% of 0.9311, outperforming LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, tabular transformers, graph neural networks, HGT, and sequence transformers. Ablation results show that leakage-controlled temporal features, self-supervised pretraining, graph encoding, tabular encoding, sequence encoding, adaptive fusion, ranking loss, and calibration loss each contribute to performance. Calibration analysis further yields a Brier score of 0.001753 and an expected calibration error of 0.0064. These findings support ADAPT ClickNet as an effective internally validated framework for leakage-controlled rare mobile install attribution with strong ranking performance and calibrated probability estimation.

论文题名

Fuzzy trust-based secure localization with CNN intrusion detection and RANSAC-GDA for wireless sensor networks

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10614-y · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have made possible many applications like environment tracking, healthcare, smart cities, etc. However, reliable node localization remains challenging due to energy constraints, noisy range estimates, and malicious adversaries. This paper proposes a hybrid secure and energy-efficient localization framework that integrates Distributed Energy-Efficient Clustering (DEEC), Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC), and a Gaussian Distribution Approach (GDA) to enable robust position estimation. In addition, a lightweight Intrusion Detection System (IDS) based on a SMOTE-assisted Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is deployed at the pre-localization stage to identify and exclude malicious nodes, including Sybil behavior and falsified localization information. DEEC-RANSAC-GDA facilitates energy-efficient selection for cluster head formation, mitigates localization outliers via RANSAC, and optimizes localization using Gaussian probabilistic models. Implementation of the proposed IDS on the CIC-IDS-2017 benchmark dataset achieved 99.83% accuracy, 99.00% precision, 99.84% recall, and 99.42% F1-score, along with minimizing localization errors falling within the range of 0.46 m-0.53 m compared to DV-Hop and Weighted Hyperbolic Localization schemes.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Learning-based modality selection for efficient multimodal retrieval

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10733-6 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Existing multimodal retrieval-augmented systems (RAG) typically retrieve both text and images for every query, including queries that can be answered using only textual information. This wastes computational resources and increases latency. We frame modality selection as a supervised classification problem in which a lightweight classifier determines whether visual retrieval is necessary, and we evaluate two variants based on when this decision is made. In the post-retrieval case, the classifier relies on image-relevance features and therefore requires image retrieval for every query; it can only save the time spent processing the retrieved images. The pre-retrieval-only classifier uses four features available after text retrieval and before visual retrieval, allowing the visual branch to be skipped for text-only queries. On a collection of 265 labeled queries over a corpus of 5,000 images, the pre-retrieval-only variant achieves 94.34% accuracy (95% Wilson interval [84.6%, 98.1%]; n = 53), with 1 unnecessary visual retrieval and 2 missed visual retrievals, while reducing measured pipeline latency from 118.97 to 65.61 ms per query, a 44.85% reduction. We compare the proposed variants with ten baselines. A query-only classifier using no retrieval information achieves 98.11%, indicating that a substantial portion of the label signal in this dataset can be recovered from the query surface form. The contribution therefore lies in the pre-retrieval routing architecture and its measured efficiency rather than classifier performance. Labels were produced by two annotators external to the author group, with Cohen’s kappa of 0.947 and complete agreement on the held-out test split. The main limitations are the small evaluation set, the fact that the queries were written by the authors, and the caption-only text corpus.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Model-agnostics for real waste management using image classification

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10531-0 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Automated waste segregation has emerged as a critical requirement for sustainable and safe urban waste management. While deep learning–based image classification models have demonstrated promising accuracy in waste identification, their black-box nature limits trust and reliability in real-world deployments. This paper presents a systematic evaluation study that combines the EfficientNet-B0 architecture with Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) to investigate not only whether a waste classifier achieves high accuracy, but also whether its correct predictions are driven by semantically meaningful visual features rather than spurious background correlations. The proposed approach was initially benchmarked on the standard CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets to establish baseline robustness, before being applied to the RealWaste dataset. The EfficientNet-based model achieves classification accuracies up to 93.08% on RealWaste, and across five random seeds, it achieves the highest mean test accuracy (91.30% ± 1.11%, vs. 90.04% ± 1.22% for ResNet50, 89.33% ± 1.13% for InceptionV3, and 86.02% ± 3.12% for MobileNetV2) while using fewer parameters than all models, except MobileNetV2. Beyond accuracy, LIME-based explanations analyze the validity of model decisions, revealing both meaningful feature utilization and instances of spurious visual correlations, supported by deletion/insertion AOPC scores and stability analysis. The study highlights the importance of combining predictive performance with explanation-driven evaluation and demonstrates the potential for explainable deep learning for future research on automated waste management. All results are based on controlled experimental conditions; scalability and real-world generalization require further validation.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Cross-Omics correlation and genomic pattern recognition for accurate tumor detection in oncological surgery decision-making

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10626-8 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

A genomic sequence analysis is necessary to determine the cancer-specific genomic patterns for oncological surgery decision-making. However, the existing works overlooked the cross-omics interaction regarding Genomic Pattern Recognition (GPR). Therefore, Chebyshev-Excoffier Heun Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Application with Noise (CEHDBSCAN)-based GPR and Cross-Omics Correlation Analysis (COCA) using Heaviside Function-based Pearson Correlation Coefficient (HeFPCC) is proposed. Primarily, the patient registers on the hospital’s server. Then, the multi-omics data is collected and then encrypted using Legendre Chi Function-based Advanced Encryption Standard (LCFAES). Further, in the hospital server, the secured multi-omics data is decrypted and pre-processed. Afterward, the CEHDBSCAN-based GPR is performed. Then, the features are extracted, and the hidden mutation progress is analyzed using Jacobi Elliptic Function-Hidden Markov Model (JEFHMM). Also, the HeFPCC-based COCA is carried out. Meanwhile, the extracted features are selected using Hawk Fish Walsh Function Optimization Algorithm (HFWaFOA). Finally, the gradients are secured using Differential Privacy (DP); then, the tumor is detected using Deep Shifted and Scaled Sigmoid Alpha Dropout Learning Neural Network (DSSSADLNN). The classified output is further given for decision-making regarding oncological surgery. Thus, the proposed framework effectively recognized the genomic pattern and classified the tumor with an accuracy of 99.05%, showing better performance than existing works.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Lyapunov Optimization with Virtual Queues for adaptive task offloading in multi access edge computing

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10660-6 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Multi-access edge computing (MEC) enhances the performance of resource-constrained devices by offloading computation to nearby edge servers, but simultaneously achieving energy efficiency and low latency under dynamic conditions remains challenging. This paper proposes Lyapunov Optimization with Virtual Queues (LOVQ), a task offloading framework based on the Lyapunov Drift Plus Penalty (LDPP) method that jointly optimizes energy consumption and delay while ensuring long-term system stability. The LOVQ framework integrates three complementary algorithms for adaptive task offloading, decay-aware updates to virtual energy queues, and battery-aware task processing under energy-constrained conditions. Simulations with 20 edge devices and 2000 tasks show that LOVQ reduces average energy consumption to 30.0 J, achieving a 33% reduction compared with local execution and a 6% reduction compared with classical Lyapunov-based offloading. LOVQ also achieves the lowest average delay of 0.92 s, reducing delay by 31% relative to local execution and exceeding random and edge-only offloading strategies. These results demonstrate that LOVQ significantly improves the energy–delay trade-off while maintaining system stability, making it a scalable solution for dynamic MEC environments.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

A deep generative adversarial framework with rat-optimized feature selection for efficient intrusion detection in large-scale cloud network traffic environments

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10557-4 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

Cloud computing is a fundamental paradigm in modern computing; however, its distributed and multi-tenant nature increases exposure to cyber threats, making effective intrusion detection essential. Despite recent advances in artificial intelligence–based intrusion detection systems (IDS), many existing approaches remain sensitive to class imbalance, computationally demanding, and insufficiently robust under large-scale network traffic conditions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an AI-driven intrusion detection framework, termed Secured Deep Generative Adversarial Rat-Optimized Diagonal Matrix (SDGA-RODM), designed for efficient intrusion detection in large-scale cloud network traffic environments. The proposed framework integrates three key components: (i) a mean divergence regularization (MDR)–based preprocessing strategy to mitigate class imbalance without altering intrinsic data distributions; (ii) a rat-optimized diagonal matrix score (RODMS)–based feature selection mechanism to derive compact and discriminative feature subsets; and (iii) a Wasserstein generative adversarial learning–based classifier (DWGALC) to enhance robustness under complex and imbalanced attack patterns. Extensive experiments conducted on the LUFlow and CIC-IDS-2017 benchmark datasets demonstrate that SDGA-RODM achieves improved performance compared with the evaluated representative IDS methods, including deep learning, ensemble-based, and optimization-driven approaches, achieving up to 6–8% improvement in detection accuracy, 15–40% reduction in classification error, and up to 30% reduction in training time under imbalanced traffic conditions. These results indicate that SDGA-RODM provides an effective and computationally efficient intrusion detection framework, demonstrating promising performance and robustness under controlled benchmark and simulation-based settings representative of cloud network traffic environments.

摘要（可展开，供朗读/NotebookLM）

论文题名

Systematic analysis of peer to peer network attacks in blockchain technology examining strategies real world cases and cross layer vulnerabilities

期刊：Discover Computing · DOI：10.1007/s10791-026-10503-4 · 语言：en · 摘要来源：Crossref 元数据

The peer-to-peer (P2P) network layer, the foundation of the system, tends to be underplayed in blockchain security conversations about headline-grabbing applications and consensus rules. This work digs deep into the P2P layer and discovers it to be a critical front for the integrity of the entire system, not passive plumbing for transactions. The complex realm of P2P attacks can be grouped into two main categories: those designed to destabilize network connections (such as Sybil, Eclipse, and BGP hijacking) and those aimed at destabilizing consensus (such as the infamous 51% attack and selfish mining). The mechanism, resource needs, and potential for pandemonium are utilized to classify each type of attack. To demonstrate that these are not merely hypothetical dangers, real-world catastrophes are analyzed, from the 2014 BGP hijacking of mining pools and the 2015 Bitcoin Eclipse attack to multiple attacks on Ethereum Classic. To better set up the ground to compare, such attacks are cataloged side by side in an easy-to-read comparative matrix. Forward-looking, the topic takes into account future threats, i.e., the growing threat of quantum attacks and the near-term threat of AI-based attacks. It also takes into account the sophisticated defenses needed to repel them, including zero-knowledge proofs and other privacy-enhancing measures. The aim is to put in the spotlight how securing the P2P layer and the expertise to build more secure blockchain systems is critical.
